gap: none found. Lens: dates. Everything ran in Playwright with seeded storage, the clock frozen or running as fake timers, and real clicks, keys and taps. Scripts are in scratchpad/recur-r11-c2/. (1) Regression re-runs of the r10 date suites against this build, checked against an independent UTC brute-force reference. matrix.mjs: 400 random completions by row checkbox, then untick and reload, on US DST nights, Dec 31, Jan 31, Feb 28/29 2027/2028 and Apr 30. matrix-tz.mjs: the same in midnight-DST and 30-minute-DST zones. paths.mjs: evening, today, someday, none and past whens with deadline, reminder and checklist, completed by card checkbox, Cmd/Ctrl+K and phone More > Complete. picker-matrix.mjs: 432 picker cases (Next note, first ring and created occurrence). feb29-chain.mjs. Result: 0 mismatches, 0 page errors. (2) NEW live midnight on an open page (clock.install + runFor, no reload) on NY normal, DST-start and DST-end nights, the Santiago midnight DST and Dec 31 to Jan 1. An open card keeps what is typed before and after midnight in both title and notes in Today (plain and This Evening), Anytime, Logbook (its Today group becomes Yesterday), a project, and Upcoming. In Upcoming the row moves from the March section into a date section and the section above it goes away. (3) NEW s5-live-walk.mjs: 24 random 40-step walks on a live running clock. Steps are row ticks, Cmd/Ctrl+K, unticks, re-dating via Cmd+S with typed dates (tomorrow, fri, in 3, 31, next month, 2/28, 12/31), and 0-72 h advances that fire the midnight redraw. Rules cover daily, every 2 days after completion, Mon+Thu, biweekly Sat+Sun, monthly by date, day 31 and last Friday, monthly after completion, yearly, and ends after 3. Whens cover today, evening, someday, none, Jan 31, Feb 28/29 and Mar 31. Start clocks cover DST nights, year end, leap day and Santiago. Each tick matched the reference for date, deadline, occurrence, anchorDay, position and copied fields. Each untick took back exactly the open occurrences whose content fingerprint was unchanged. There was never more than 1 open repeating occurrence per series, and no errors. (4) NEW s2-picker-monkey.mjs: random clicks on every Repeats control, menu, calendar day and reminder, plus random keys and digits, on desktop and phone at DST, leap, month-end and year-end clocks. The stored rule was always normal, the Next note always matched the engine, nothing was completed by stray keys, and no page errors. (5) NEW s4-twotab-date-move.mjs: tab B re-dates the occurrence while tab A types in its open card in Upcoming (row moves up, stays in its month, moves to a new month, moves into the 7-day window). The card stays open and nothing typed is lost. Seen, not claimed, because the contract allows them: (a) a card open in Upcoming on an occurrence dated tomorrow across midnight. The midnight redraw is skipped. The first key after midnight closes the card because the to-do has left Upcoming, so later keys go to Quick Find (contract: a card whose to-do leaves the list closes). (b) Today keeps finished dated to-dos. The day after ticking a daily series, Complete All then un-check in Today also reopens yesterday's finished occurrence as a one-off. This is TodoMVC toggle-all, and the contract's one-off rule.
